inputs: Re-verify an electronic cover's body/header pins and one report-metadata capture with an explicit inclusive window. Never accept caller-selected membership or trusted review JSON.
scope_binding: A complete 8.4 document has exactly one supported financial cover and valid identity/period.
The posted file ID has an exact metadata observation and is a verified observed-chain candidate under report-period-membership v1.
Metadata traversal is complete at observation time. Committee, form, literal report code, period and amendment indicator agree. The report is entirely inside the requested window.
An amended chain's HDR original report ID matches its first chain member. The positive one-to-three-digit amendment sequence is preserved but does not rank versions or establish an amendment count.
A singleton chain has a non-amendment cover and blank HDR amendment identity fields. Paper/mixed cohorts and prefix captures never bind.
field_binding: Every mapped cover position and the metadata field must contain a valid explicit amount. Repeated cover positions agree, and metadata minus cover is exactly zero. Failures stay local to the field; source values remain unchanged.
interpretation: reported_value_bound attaches matching reported observations to one observed chain candidate. It is not a complete financial report, donor composition, clean cash balance, whole-window membership, or inferred missing amount.
